ad_inject.description: Configuration of injecting advertising video clips into played stream.

midroll.description:
The paths to the mid-roll advertising files in a VOD location.

You may choose the mid-roll mode using the `midroll_insert_by` parameter.

The order of mid-roll playback is defined by the order of values in the array.

oneOf.description: All ad files are played in the specified order once every `midroll_interval`.
oneOf.title: Interval

oneOf.description:
You can use this option if your stream has SCTE-35 or SCTE-104 markers.

The ad files are played in the specified order (looped, from the beginning of the array) 
until a marker for switching to the main stream is received,
or until the end of the advertisement slot (whichever comes first).
oneOf.title: Splicing

midroll_interval.description:
The interval between showing mid-roll advertisement files. 
Use with `midroll_insert_by=interval` only.

midroll_program_id.description:
You can use this option to choose SCTE-35 or SCTE-104 markers having this program_id only for this mid-roll.
Use with `midroll_insert_by=splicing` only.

preroll.description:
The paths to the pre-roll advertising files in a VOD location.

All the pre-roll files are played before switching to the main stream:

* live main stream is *replaced* by the pre-roll so the content may be overlapped by the ads.
* VOD main stream is entirely played after the pre-roll without overlapping like in a playlist.

The order of pre-roll playback is defined by the order of values in the array.

v.description:
The version of ad insertion mechanism used by Flussonic: 

* `v=1` is an extension of the authorization system, it works with HLS and DASH protocols only. 
The ad is inserted to the manifest (playlist), so plugins such as AdBlock can detect and block the advertisement.

* `v=2` (default) provides more resistance to ad blockers. 
The ad replaces the stream segments within the play session so that it is impossible to distinguish 
whether it is a main stream segment or an ad segment. 
It also allows you to customize the advertisements for a particular user. 
Besides, it works with a single-period as well as a multi-period DASH.

allowed_dvr_ranges.description:
Permitted DVR intervals.
By default when no allowed_dvr_ranges defined all archive is available for requests.
Empty list means no access.

items.description: 'opened_at' or 'closed_at' can be omitted (not both), which means open interval.

code.description: an application-specific error code, expressed as a string value

id.description: a unique identifier for this particular occurrence of the problem

meta.description: a meta object containing non-standard meta-information about the error.

source.description: an object containing references to the source of the error

parameter.description: a string indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

pointer.description:
a JSON Pointer [RFC6901] to the associated entity in the request document
[e.g. `"/data"` for a primary data object, or `"/data/attributes/title"` for a specific attribute].

status.description: the HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value

title.description:
a short, human-readable summary of the problem that SHOULD NOT change from
occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization

info.description:
This API describes how Flussonic streaming server connects to an external authorization backend 
to check if the user is allowed to access a stream or a VOD file.

Permanent [download link](https://flussonic.com/doc/api/authorization.json) to JSON schema file.

This specification does not have any external dependencies and is designed to be as minimal,
as possible for reducing needs of maintaining unneeded backward compatibility.

This API is designed to be implementable by third parties.
info.title: Flussonic Authorization Backend API

get.description: This method describes what Flussonic sends to an authorization backend for playing session and what it awaits as a response.

parameters.description: Stream or VOD file name for this session.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: IP address of the media client who initiated this session.
parameters.name: ip

parameters.description:
Is it a request for a new session or an update request.

The value `new_session` is used for a start of a new session and `update_session` - for an existing session.
parameters.name: request_type

parameters.description: Counter of auth requests for this session, starting from 0.
parameters.name: request_number

parameters.description: Unique session id. It will be the same for one session.
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.description: How many clients are currently watching this stream or VOD file.
parameters.name: stream_clients

parameters.description: How many clients are currently watching from this server.
parameters.name: total_clients

parameters.description:
User provided authorization token.

The token is generated automatically or received from a website.
parameters.name: token

parameters.description: If it is an update request, then it will be the duration of this session in seconds.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: How many bytes have been passed in this session.
parameters.name: bytes

parameters.description:
Here may go initial query string that was passed by client.
Use it for additional authorization.
parameters.name: qs

parameters.description: Is it a session for playing DVR archive.
parameters.name: dvr

parameters.description: Many protocols can signal a user agent. It will be provided in this field.
parameters.name: user_agent

parameters.description: Referer HTTP header that identifies the address of the web page from which the request was made.
parameters.name: referer

parameters.description: A value of Host HTTP Header.
parameters.name: host

200.description: Access granted. Here you can pass additional session settings (like advertising).

X-AuthDuration.description:
During this amount of seconds this session will be considered alive
and no additional requests will be made.

If a session has been banned,
any attempt to reopen it within the period of `X-AuthDuration` will be rejected by Flussonic Media Server.

X-Max-Sessions.description:
How many opened sessions are allowed with this user id.

For example, if it is set to 2 and a user tries to view 3 streams simultaneously, one of them will be interrupted.

X-Unique.description: Only one opened session is allowed with this user id. Analog for `X-Max-Sessions: 1`

X-UserId.description:
Authorization backend can supply user id of this session.
It can be used for reporting statistics and for limiting simultaneous amount of
opened sessions.

302.description: Redirect client to a different URL. e.g. a new stream path or backup clip.

schema.description: The URL that the Player will open for playback.
